title: Hold working with children checks
what: Make sure people doing child-related work hold the state's working with children check (or equivalent).

laws.title: Working with Vulnerable People (Background Checking) Act 2011

sources.title: Working with vulnerable people registration
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this registration if you will have regular contact with vulnerable people while working or volunteering in a regulated activity.

reach.condition: if its people do child-related work
